description: This file defines the HelpService class within the OrangeHRM Help plugin. It provides methods to access help configuration, retrieve a help processor, and generate redirect URLs, primarily facilitating help-related functionalities within the system.

classes.name: HelpService
classes.description: Service class for handling help-related functionalities, including configuration retrieval, processing help redirects, and URL validation.

methods.name: getHelpConfigService
methods.description: Returns the HelpConfigService instance, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: getHelpProcessor
methods.description: Retrieves the help processor instance, instantiating it dynamically based on configuration if not already set.

methods.name: getRedirectUrl
methods.description: Delegates to the help processor to obtain a redirect URL based on a label.

methods.name: getDefaultRedirectUrl
methods.description: Retrieves the default redirect URL via the help processor.

methods.name: isValidUrl
methods.description: Validates the base help URL from configuration.
